draft_en.subject: PoE switches for your camera and home-automation installations - two units from single pieces
draft_en.body:
Hello Basithami team,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "Managed PoE Switches" on 6 October 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the PoE switches in your camera and home-automation installations (Utepo today), from single units, EXW, 15-day validity, CE/RoHS: 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed, Marvell-based - model STC-28DGGPM - $84.1 USD; DIN-rail industrial 8 x PoE+ + 2 x SFP, unmanaged, -40 to 75 C, for outdoor boxes - STI-288GP - $60. Shipping by courier; DAP to your city on request.

One question: which PoE port count do your installations use most - 4, 8 or 16?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
